sources.title: Lectures on Gauged Supergravity and Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can supergravity gaugings be constructed covariantly under the ungauged theory's duality group, and how do their deformation parameters encode geometric, p-form and non-geometric fluxes?

sources.title: Introductory Lectures on Extended Supergravities and Gaugings

evidence.text: How does gauging deform extended supergravity to introduce gauge interactions, fermion masses and a scalar potential while preserving local supersymmetry, and how does the embedding tensor organize dualities and flux compactifications?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: The low-energy vector sector of 5d N=1 supergravity is encoded by a cubic polynomial. The relevant data include both gauge Chern–Simons coefficients and mixed gauge/gravitational coefficients, with charged massive fields already removed from the generic Coulomb-branch description.

sources.title: Survey of supergravities

evidence.text: Which supergravities, matter couplings and gaugings have been constructed across dimensions, and how can their component formulations and duality-covariant descriptions be summarized?

sources.title: N=8 matter coupled AdS(3) supergravities

evidence.text: Which subgroups of SO(8,n) can be gauged while preserving D=3, N=8 local supersymmetry, and can a resulting SO(4) theory reproduce the symmetries and massless spectrum of six-dimensional (2,0) supergravity on AdS3×S3?

sources.title: New couplings of six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity be coupled simultaneously to arbitrary numbers of tensor, vector and hypermultiplets, including gauging, and what singularities and anomaly constraints accompany these couplings?

sources.title: The Gauging of five-dimensional, N=2 Maxwell-Einstein supergravity theories coupled to tensor multiplets

evidence.text: Which gaugings of five-dimensional N=2 Maxwell–Einstein supergravity remain supersymmetric when charged spectator vectors become tensor multiplets, and what restrictions follow for scalar potentials, AdS vacua, gauge groups and tensor representations?

sources.title: Lectures on Gauged Supergravity and Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Use coset currents J=V⁻¹dV=Q+P and the scalar kinetic term −e Tr(PμP^μ)/2. Supersymmetric completion uses the Noether procedure, with the scalar-dressed embedding tensor supplying fermion mass tensors.

sources.title: Introductory Lectures on Extended Supergravities and Gaugings

evidence.text: Coset geometry uses L(φ), the Maurer–Cartan form L⁻¹dL=P+w, its coset vielbein and composite H-connection. For symmetric spaces, curvature and the sigma-model metric follow from Maurer–Cartan identities and a representation-dependent trace normalization.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: The geometric analysis uses Hodge index and Lefschetz theorems, Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch, and minimal-surface inequalities to relate divisor invariants to central charges and gauge-rank bounds.

sources.title: Survey of supergravities

evidence.text: Summarizes constructions using the Noether procedure, superconformal tensor calculus and embedding tensors. Embedding tensors select gauge generators; supersymmetry and gauge-algebra closure impose linear and quadratic constraints, with tensor hierarchies supplying additional form potentials.

sources.title: N=8 matter coupled AdS(3) supergravities

evidence.text: Noether deformation of the ungauged theory, with a Chern-Simons term, covariantized coset currents, scalar-dependent fermion couplings and a scalar potential. The displayed action and transformations omit higher fermionic terms inherited from the ungauged construction.

sources.title: New couplings of six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Start from transformation and field-equation ansätze with unknown coefficients, impose supersymmetry closure modulo field equations, and require equations to transform into one another. Closure on bosons already uses tensor duality equations; the construction is not an off-shell closure argument.

sources.title: All couplings of minimal six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Construct the complete low-energy coupling of six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity to tensor, vector and charged hypermultiplets, including anomalous interactions, abelian kinetic mixing and a Lorentz-covariant treatment of chiral tensors.

sources.title: Unified N=2 Maxwell-Einstein and Yang-Mills-Einstein supergravity theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional N=2 Maxwell–Einstein supergravity theories obtained from known five-dimensional theories admit a simple Lagrangian symmetry acting irreducibly on every electric vector, including the graviphoton, and which permit unified Yang–Mills gaugings?

sources.title: Dimensional Reduction of the Heterotic String over nearly-Kaehler manifolds

evidence.text: What four-dimensional bosonic effective action and N=1 supergravity data result from reducing ten-dimensional heterotic supergravity–Yang-Mills on homogeneous non-symmetric cosets admitting nearly-Kähler structures?

sources.title: M-theory and gauged supergravities

evidence.text: How do dimensional reductions produce gauged maximal supergravities with string/M-theory origins, when do their consistent field equations admit actions, and how are their supersymmetric domain walls related to higher-dimensional branes?

sources.title: The higher-dimensional origin of five-dimensional $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Which five-dimensional N=2 matter contents, scalar manifolds and gaugings are algebraically compatible with consistent truncations of higher-dimensional supergravity?

sources.title: Flat deformations of type IIB S-folds

evidence.text: What group-theoretical mechanism makes axion-like S-fold deformations flat, how are they interpreted in five dimensions, and can it generate nonsupersymmetric deformations of the N = 4, SO(4)-symmetric S-fold that remain perturbatively stable in four-dimensional supergravity?

sources.title: Higher derivative couplings with multi-tensor multiplets in 6D supergravity, action and anomalies

evidence.text: Construct a proper action for six-dimensional (1,0) supergravity with multiple tensor multiplets and gauge anomalies, and obtain the leading supersymmetric gravitational Green–Schwarz curvature-squared counterterm with matter couplings.

sources.title: Options for gauge groups in five-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which compact global symmetries can be gauged in five-dimensional N=2 supergravity, and what restrictions do local supersymmetry and physical kinetic terms impose on scalar geometry, vector fields and tensor representations?

sources.title: Unified Maxwell-Einstein and Yang-Mills-Einstein supergravity theories in five-dimensions

evidence.text: Do five-dimensional N=2 unified Maxwell-Einstein supergravities exist beyond homogeneous scalar manifolds, and which admit a simple gauge group acting on every vector, including the graviphoton?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: How are scalar and vector couplings organized after supersymmetric circle reduction from six to five dimensions?

sources.title: Supergravities: From fields to branes

evidence.text: How is eleven-dimensional supergravity constructed by deforming a free supersymmetric theory, and how can its toroidally reduced bosonic matter equations acquire a universal self-duality form, with possible quantum and gravitational extensions?

sources.title: Consistent Kaluza-Klein Truncations and Two-Dimensional Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reduction of E9 exceptional field theory determine the scalar potential of upliftable two-dimensional maximal gauged supergravities and constructively establish the SO(9) sphere truncation?

sources.title: N=2 supergravity and N=2 superYang-Mills theory on general scalar manifolds: Symplectic covariance, gaugings and the momentum map

evidence.text: How can general matter-coupled N=2 supergravity, its isometry gaugings and scalar potential be formulated geometrically without requiring special coordinates or a holomorphic prepotential, and how does the rigid theory emerge?

sources.title: Hitchin functionals in N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: How can type II supergravity on backgrounds admitting eight selected supercharges be organized in an N=2-like form, and how do intrinsic torsion and fluxes determine its geometry, prepotentials and possible four-dimensional truncations?

sources.title: Tri-Sasakian consistent reduction

evidence.text: Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

sources.title: Maximal D = 2 supergravities from higher dimensions

evidence.text: How can the complete bosonic dynamics, especially the scalar potential, be constructed for maximal gauged D=2 supergravities admitting consistent geometric uplifts to ten or eleven dimensions?

sources.title: Supersymmetric domain walls in maximal 6D gauged supergravity III

evidence.text: Which consistent six-dimensional maximal gaugings arise from the R+×SO(4,4) decomposition of the embedding tensor, and which half-supersymmetric domain walls can be constructed in selected invariant scalar sectors?

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent truncations around eleven-dimensional AdS₅ vacua preserving 16 supercharges yield five-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity with vector multiplets, and what restricts their matter content and gaugings?

evidence.text: How can the complete dynamical bosonic SU(3)-invariant sector of electric SO(8)-gauged four-dimensional maximal supergravity be embedded consistently in eleven dimensions, and does it yield an additional truncation to minimal N=2 gauged supergravity?

evidence.text: What shared lower-dimensional structure permits comparison of the four ten-dimensional theories? Toroidal reduction gives a common orthogonal scalar coset and generic Abelian gauge fields, allowing the paper to compare duality identifications and charged classical solutions.

evidence.text: Can consistent supersymmetric Kaluza–Klein truncations retain the massive breathing-mode multiplet alongside the massless graviton multiplet, and can the resulting lower-dimensional theories generate exact higher-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIB supergravity on general squashed Sasaki–Einstein five-manifolds admit a finite, nonlinear, consistent truncation retaining the massive KK states dual to the universal gauge sector?

sources.title: On \alpha' corrections in N=1 F-theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which corrections to four-dimensional N=1 F-theory effective actions follow from classical reduction of the known purely gravitational eleven-dimensional R^4 terms, survive the F-theory limit, and admit a weakly coupled Type IIB interpretation?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction of the M-theory Chern-Simons term at order <math display="inline"><msubsup><mo>ℓ</mo><mi>p</mi><mn>6</mn></msubsup></math>

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Uplift the source system, retain its assumed geometrical Bianchi identity, and change the reduction circle. Map both curvature and signed sources to identify the resulting ten-dimensional RR identity and compare consistency conditions.

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: Shift the seed's asymptotic radius above one, rotate its charge into a ten-dimensional gauge U(1), and rescale the final internal modulus. This isolates a finite Wilson-line-zero locus outside the repulson without relying on geometric self-duality there.

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Extract masses from quadratic fluctuations around the AdS vacuum and infer dual operator dimensions. For weak G2 reductions, identify an N=1 scalar description using φ=e^v+ih and K=−7 log(φ+φ̄).

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Expand fields in the globally defined structure forms η, J and Ω, whose algebra closes under exterior differentiation and Hodge duality. Substitution into ten-dimensional equations removes internal-coordinate dependence, providing the authors' consistency argument.

sources.title: Duality orbits of non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: Gauge closure and bracket antisymmetry determine quadratic constraints. Polynomial solutions are obtained using the Gianni–Trager–Zacharias primary-decomposition algorithm in Singular, then grouped under duality transformations.

sources.title: On \alpha' corrections in N=1 F-theory compactifications

evidence.text: Adjunction expresses fourfold Chern classes through base classes. Scaling in the shrinking elliptic-fiber limit selects surviving terms; corrected variables and Legendre duality organize the Kähler potential and no-scale identities.
